missing_policy.source: 所查官方页面/PDF未给出缺失题插补规则。
missing_policy.project_policy: NO gate is an intentional structural skip with total0, not missing-data imputation. YES requires all5 valid answers. Missing gate or missing required symptom cannot score.

report.title: 了解困扰留下的影响
report.meaning: 这份记录整理了你最近一个月的体验，帮助你和专业人员交流；它不是诊断，也不评价你是否坚强。
report.life_example: 相似的提醒、睡眠变化或在人群中的感受，可能影响不同人的日常生活；请以你实际经历为准。
report.reflection: 哪些体验最影响你的睡眠、日常安排或与人相处？有没有你希望向专业人员说明、但题目没有问到的部分？
report.action: 可以把最想讨论的体验记下来，在合适的专业评估中说明。你无需在报告中公开事件细节。
report.limits: 较少勾选或较低得分不代表没有困扰、没有风险，也不能排除需要帮助。当前中文工作稿不提供自动诊断、严重程度标签或中国人群比较。
report.illustration_brief: 可选抽象日常记录卡插图，不出现创伤场景、病名标签或风险仪表盘。
report.gate_no: 你未报告题目列出的这类经历，因此按原量表规则到此结束。这不代表已经逐项了解你的所有体验，也不代表没有其他困扰。

name_en: Primary Care PTSD Screen for DSM-5 (PC-PTSD-5)
name_zh: 基层医疗创伤后应激障碍筛查（PC-PTSD-5）
citation: Prins, A., Bovin, M. J., Kimerling, R., Kaloupek, D. G., Marx, B. P., Pless Kaiser, A., & Schnurr, P. P. (2015). Primary Care PTSD Screen for DSM-5 (PC-PTSD-5) [Measurement instrument]. National Center for PTSD.
timeframe: Lifetime exposure gate, followed by past-month symptoms / 终生暴露门题，随后过去一个月体验

exposure_gate.instruction_en: Sometimes things happen to people that are unusually or especially frightening, horrible, or traumatic. For example:
exposure_gate.instruction_zh: 有时，人们会经历异常或特别令人害怕、恐怖或造成创伤的事情。例如：
examples_en: a physical or sexual assault or abuse
seeing someone be killed or seriously injured
having a loved one die through homicide or suicide.
examples_zh: 身体或性方面的侵犯或虐待
目睹有人被杀害或严重受伤
所爱的人死于他杀或自杀。
exposure_gate.question_en: Have you ever experienced this kind of event?
exposure_gate.question_zh: 你是否曾经经历过这类事件？

no_branch.instruction_en: If no, screen total = 0. Please stop here.
no_branch.instruction_zh: 如果回答“否”，筛查总分为0。请到此停止。
no_branch.report_distinguish: 按未报告所列经历的停止规则结束；并非已否认五项症状，不意味着排除困扰或风险。

yes_branch.instruction_en: If yes, please answer the questions below.
yes_branch.instruction_zh: 如果回答“是”，请回答下面的问题。

exposure_gate.missing_branch: Stop, incomplete, no total. Never treat missing exposure as NO.

stem_en: In the past month, have you...
stem_zh: 在过去一个月里，你是否……

items.en: had nightmares about the event(s) or thought about the event(s) when you did not want to?
items.zh: 做过与那件事（或那些事）有关的噩梦，或者在不想回想时仍想到那件事（或那些事）？

items.en: tried hard not to think about the event(s) or went out of your way to avoid situations that reminded you of the event(s)?
items.zh: 努力不去想那件事（或那些事），或特意避开会让你想起那件事（或那些事）的情境？

items.en: been constantly on guard, watchful, or easily startled?
items.zh: 一直保持戒备、留意周围，或容易受惊？

items.en: felt numb or detached from people, activities, or your surroundings?
items.zh: 感到麻木，或与他人、活动或周围环境疏离？

items.en: felt guilty or unable to stop blaming yourself or others for the event(s) or any problems the event(s) may have caused?
items.zh: 因为那件事（或那些事）或它们可能造成的任何问题而感到内疚，或无法停止责怪自己或他人？

scoring.total: If gate NO then 0 and stop; if gate YES then sum of YES in symptom items 1–5
scoring.direction: Higher = more endorsed past-month experiences; not diagnosis
scoring.routing_implementation_gate: Do not instantiate executable instrument unless exposure gate is required, NO branch stops with 0, YES branch requires all 5 items, and missing gate cannot score. The 5 symptoms cannot be substituted as standalone form or ordinary six-item summed scale.

external_reference_dossier.purpose: Balance false positives and negatives in original overall/male sample; positive screen requires further assessment
external_reference_dossier.population: 396 US veterans seeking VA primary care; mean age 61.4 (SD15.5), range21–93;333 men (84.1%); not Chinese or school population
external_reference_dossier.female_caution: At cutpoint4 female sensitivity0.67 and 6 of18 CAPS-5-positive women missed; lower cutpoint may be considered by clinicians depending on setting/resources. Do not auto-assign cutoff by user sex.
external_reference_dossier.citation: Bovin MJ, Kimerling R, Weathers FW, et al. (2021). Diagnostic Accuracy and Acceptability of the PC-PTSD-5 Among US Veterans. JAMA Network Open,4(2),e2036733.
external_reference_dossier.limitations: Clinical screening, not diagnosis. Performance changes by population and purpose; no norm/threshold validated for this Chinese working translation. No automatic active cut-point.

test_vectors.expect: skip symptom pages; gate-based report, not symptoms absent report
contradictory payload must not sum to5; reject inconsistent stale symptom data or explicitly clear before scoring

implementationStatus.note: 仅公开研究资料，未采用删字段或把原门题改为普通计分题的简化方式。源包privacy中的替代呈现建议未实施。
